notes: no schedule key exists in the .nika file (NIKA-PARSE-005); nika arm shows when each beat next fires and acquires nothing. Activating a READY beat is its own effect (nika arm --emit launchd --write, then loading the unit), carried out when the person's instruction covers it: one scoped instruction can cover the Save, a run and the activation, once. A beat is paused with actif: false, raison: and jusqu_au:. Cadences nika arm reads: TZ=Europe/Paris 0 8 * * * (five cron fields after the zone: every day at 08:00); TZ=Europe/Paris 0 */6 * * * (every six hours, in cron); TZ=Indian/Mauritius 30 7 * * 1-5 (weekdays at 07:30); TZ=Europe/Paris 7 9 * * 1,3 (Monday and Wednesday at 09:07: several days are a cron list); TZ=Europe/Paris lundi 9h07 (one French weekday and a time); TZ=Europe/Paris every 2 weeks from 2026-10-12 09:00 (a period in whole weeks from a first instant); TZ=Europe/Paris 0 8 1 * * (the 1st of every month at 08:00: a day of the month is the third cron field). Refused there: 0 8 * * * (no zone: cadence.tz-missing); dimanche 18h07 (no zone: cadence.tz-missing); TZ=Europe/Paris toutes les 6h (a French phrase for a period: cadence.field-count); TZ=Europe/Paris chaque jour à 09:00 (a French daily phrase: cadence.field-count); TZ=Europe/Paris every day at 09:00 (a period in days: cadence.phrase-syntax); TZ=Europe/Paris lundi,mercredi 9h07 (two days in the French form: cadence.phrase-syntax); TZ=Europe/Paris le 1er de chaque mois à 8h (a French monthly phrase: the person's words become 0 8 1 * *: cadence.field-count). Missed-slot rules it fires: sauter (a missed slot is skipped); rattraper-une-fois (one catch-up run for the slots missed). Not fired there, never offered as a choice: rattraper (the latest missed slot, run once: UNREADY, policy_unsupported); { rattraper: 3 } (up to the 3 latest missed slots, one run each: UNREADY, policy_unsupported).
purpose: The workflow runs once per firing; the project's nika.yaml arms it: an arm entry names the workflow file, its cadence with the zone inside (TZ=Indian/Mauritius 0 8 * * *), plafond (the spend ceiling of one firing) and manqué (what a missed slot does, among the rules the targeted binary fires). The zone, plafond and manqué come from what the person gave, what the project keeps or what they delegated; only one still missing is asked, once.
